# PNEUMOCYSTIS JIROVECII PROPHYLAXIS

Indications for primary prophylaxis of P. jirovecii include:

1) HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 count <200 cells/microliter
2) Hematopoietic or organ transplantation patients during immunosuppression
3) Patients receiving Alemtuzumab, temozolomide or fludarabine
4) Patients receiving >/= 20mg equivalent of prednisone per day for over 1 month
5) Patients with acute lymphocytic leukemia, rheumatologic disease receiving immunosuppressive therapy and certain primary immunodeficiencies (e.g. severe combined immunodeficiency, idiopathic CD4 T-lymphocytopenia, hyper-IgM syndrome)

Dose and duration of prophylaxis varies with the indication. Please contact Infectious Diseases or Hematology/Oncology for more information.
Prophylaxis should be discontinued when host defenses are restored. In persons with AIDS on highly active antiretroviral therapy, Prophylaxis should be discontinued when the CD4 cell concentrations remain over 200 cells/microliter for 3-6 months in patients, except that prophylaxis should be continued for in those those who have had P. jirovecii disease.

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Recommended FIRST-LINE prophylaxis:

Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet QD ($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 SS tablet QD ($) [R,DI] when trimethoprim/sulfa is poorly tolerated or contraindicated:

\*\*Patient should be tested for glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6-PD) deficiency before starting dapsone. Individuals deficient in G6-PD show about a 2-fold increase in sensitivity toward dapsone-induced hemolytic anemia.

G6-PD lab result should be "normal" to start dapsone therapy.
G6-PD Screen Lab Order
Dapsone 100mg PO q day ($) [DI]

### Alternative to the above preferred regimens:

### Atovaquone is alternative for patient for clinical reason:

(e.g. patients with SLE, hematologic concerns, G6PD deficiency)
Atovaquone 1500mg q day for PCP prophylaxis ($$) [DI]

Alternative to the above regimens:
Due to efficacy and complicated logistics for administration, alternative when above recommendations not appropriate for patient.
Pentamidine 300mg Inhalation QMONTH ($) [DI,O] <AND> Albuterol 0.083% inhalation QMONTH ($) [M]
